claim: Missing package from drop box : r/FedEx - Reddit
summary: I had dropped off a package in a FedEx drop box and had it go missing. It was never scanned. I spoke with several customer service reps from the 1800 number, one recommended that I wait for the delivery driver and speak with him, which I ended up doing. He was nice and let me look in the drop box but it did not locate my package. I then went to the shipping hub and spoke with a few employees ...
